title: Vegetable Manchow Soup
description: Vegetable Manchow Soup is a vibrant Indo-Chinese soup packed with crisp vegetables, aromatic seasoning, and a lightly thickened savory broth. Finished with fresh bean sprouts, spring onions, and crunchy fried noodles, it delivers the signature combination of silky soup and crisp textures found in restaurant-style Manchow Soup.

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: Bell peppers – ½ cup, thinly sliced (optional)
Mushrooms – ½ cup, sliced (shiitake or button)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Vegetables
steps: Wash and prepare all vegetables thoroughly.
Julienne the carrots and thinly slice the remaining vegetables for even cooking.
Keep the bean sprouts and spring onions separate, as they will be added toward the end.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Soup Base
steps: Add the vegetable stock and water to a large wok or saucepan.
Bring the liquid to a gentle boil.
Add soy sauce, white pepper, salt, sesame oil, and sugar.
Taste the broth and adjust the seasoning as needed.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking the Vegetables
steps: Add carrots, cabbage, bell peppers if using, and sliced mushrooms to the simmering broth.
Cook over medium heat for 3–4 minutes.
Keep the vegetables slightly crisp rather than fully soft for the characteristic Manchow texture.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Thickening the Soup
steps: Mix the cornstarch with 3 tbsp water until completely smooth.
Slowly pour the slurry into the simmering soup while stirring continuously.
Cook for approximately 2 minutes until the soup becomes lightly thickened and velvety.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Adding the Optional Egg
steps: Reduce the heat to low.
Slowly drizzle the beaten eggs into the soup while stirring gently in one direction.
Allow thin egg ribbons to form without vigorously stirring the broth.
Skip this step for a vegetarian preparation without egg.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Final Touches
steps: Add the bean sprouts and chopped spring onions.
Turn off the heat immediately to preserve their freshness and crunch.
Drizzle with sesame oil for a final aromatic finish.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Serving
steps: Ladle the hot soup into warmed serving bowls.
Top generously with crispy fried noodles for the signature Manchow presentation.
Garnish with additional chopped spring onions if desired.
Serve immediately while the soup is hot and the noodles remain crisp.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as an Indo-Chinese appetizer.
Top with crispy fried noodles immediately before serving for maximum crunch.
Pair with vegetable fried rice, Hakka noodles, spring rolls, or other Indo-Chinese dishes.
Offer chili sauce or chili oil on the side for guests who prefer additional heat.

chefTips: Use fresh, colorful vegetables for better flavor, texture, and visual appeal.
Keep the vegetables slightly crunchy rather than overcooking them.
Do not over-thicken the broth; it should be silky and velvety rather than gelatinous.
Add bean sprouts and spring onions near the end so they retain freshness and crunch.
For deeper flavor, add a few drops of rice wine or a small amount of mushroom soy sauce.
Add fried noodles only when serving so they remain crisp and provide the signature Manchow texture contrast.
For a fully vegan version, omit the egg and verify that the soy sauce, noodles, and other packaged ingredients are vegan.
